title: Reader Journey Workspace Layout Audit v4.0

AppShell.notes: System nav occupies left 200px track; journey content lives in main.

SystemSidebar.notes: First of three left chrome layers (nav → SourcePane → tool rail).

SourcePane.notes: Competes with tool rail for left horizontal space; collapse frees chart width but still leaves 36px strip.

MainJourneyPane.notes: Not an independent grid column today; stacked above Inspector in JourneyResizableSplit.

button_labels.truncation_cause: fixed 56px rail + nowrap ellipsis on Chinese labels

PhaseNavigation.notes: Above chart shell; competes for vertical chrome with tool rail row on narrow.

CanonicalJourneyChart.notes: v3.0 plot floors are valid; layout failure is chrome around the plot, not Y-scale.

SceneNavigator.notes: Correctly placed under plot in v3.0; must remain outside Inspector DOM.

why_floats_over_chart.primary: Inspector is not a peer grid column of the chart; expand consumes vertical space in the same column, and overview/workspace overflow:auto creates a second scroll while chart shell remains in view — users perceive detail as covering the plot viewport when scrolling or when stacked height exceeds available main height.
why_floats_over_chart.positioning_context: .journey-overview-pane { position:relative; z-index:1 } and collapsed detail uses position:absolute (zero-size hide), establishing absolute positioning habits in the same tree.
why_floats_over_chart.not_css_fixed_over_svg: Inspector itself is not position:fixed over the SVG in default desktop expand; Human UAT still fails because expand competes in the same vertical track and does not reflow as a right dock releasing chart width.
why_floats_over_chart.containing_block_for_collapsed_slot: .journey-resizable-split (position static → nearest positioned ancestor or padding box)

Dropdown_Popover_Modal.tool_rail_flyouts: absolute; no Portal; no viewport clamp

answers_required.1_why_inspector_floats_on_chart: Vertical JourneyResizableSplit places Inspector under Overview in one column; expand does not allocate a dedicated non-overlapping dock column beside the chart. Combined with workspace overflow:auto and absolute-hidden collapsed slot, detail expansion visually competes with / covers chart chrome instead of pushing a peer pane.
answers_required.2_positioning_context: Nearest positioned ancestors include .journey-overview-pane (relative, z-index:1) and absolute rules on .journey-detail-collapsed-slot; flyouts use .journey-tool-rail-item (relative).
answers_required.4_buttons_clipped: Tool rail fixed 56px + .journey-tool-rail-label ellipsis; icons 指/全/P/详/出 are the only reliably visible glyphs.
answers_required.6_main_pane_min_usable_width: SplitPane enforces minWidth 400 on journey secondary when source expanded; after 56px rail, plot viewport ≈ secondary−56. At 1440 with ~46% source, journey ~650–700px before rail — below v4.0 minmax(720px,1fr) Main requirement when Source+Inspector both open.

architecture_verdict.required_change: Replace vertical tool rail + vertical Inspector split with CSS Grid Source|Main|Inspector, horizontal toolbar, docked Inspector, unified scroll ownership.
